WithinHostExperiment: Container for within-host pathogen variant data

Source: R/AllClasses.R, R/methods.R
WithinHostExperiment-class.Rd

Extends RangedSummarizedExperiment-class to hold intra-host single nucleotide variant (iSNV) data with integrated quality control audit logging.

Subsetting preserves the qcLog and qcFilters slots. These slots are experiment-level metadata (not row/column-dependent) and are carried forward unchanged.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'WithinHostExperiment'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'WithinHostExperiment,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

Arguments

object

A WithinHostExperiment object.

x

A WithinHostExperiment.

i

Row indices (variant sites).

j

Column indices (samples).

...

Additional arguments passed to the parent method.

drop

Logical (ignored for SummarizedExperiment).

Value

A WithinHostExperiment.

Slots

qcLog

DataFrame. Audit trail of QC filtering steps.

qcFilters

list. History of ISNVFilter objects that have been applied. Validity checks each one, so a filter saved by an earlier version of the package, or changed with @<- into an invalid one, is reported, and the object cannot be subset or combined until the filter is rebuilt with ISNVFilter and stored with qcFilters<-.

Standard assays

altCount

Integer matrix. Alternative allele read counts.

refCount

Integer matrix. Reference allele read counts.

totalDepth

Integer matrix. Total read depth.

altFreq

Numeric matrix. Alt allele frequencies (0-1).

qcPass

Logical matrix. TRUE = passed QC, FALSE = flagged. Initialized to all TRUE; updated by flagISNV. No package function writes NA, but one set by hand counts as not passed wherever an analysis uses only passing calls.

Assays must be ordinary R matrices. Out-of-memory backends such as DelayedArray or HDF5Array are not supported: the validity method refuses a qcPass assay that is not a base logical matrix, and flagISNV combines assays with base R operators.

Expected colData columns

sample_id

Character. Unique sample identifier (required).

host_id

Character. Host/patient identifier (optional).

replicate_group

Character. Technical replicate group identifier (optional).

replicate_id

Character. Replicate number within group (optional).

role

Character. Sample role: "donor", "recipient", or "independent" (optional).

pair_id

Character. Transmission pair identifier (optional).

See also

readWithinHost and readWithinHostTable for constructing from files. flagISNV for quality control. passedISNV for extracting QC-passed variants. transmissionPairs for extracting donor-recipient pairs.

Examples

data(example_whe)
example_whe
#> WithinHostExperiment with 28 variant sites and 3 samples
#>   assays(5): altFreq, totalDepth, refCount, altCount, qcPass
#>   qcLog: 0 filtering step(s)
#>   transmission pairs: 1
